name: Antonino Colosimo
bioAdditions: Antonino was born on 19 January 1685, son of Antonio Colosimo and Giovanna Ierra (indexed 'Jersa') (S1). His wife, mother of Francesco (1719), was Antonia Mendicino (S2).
